observations: In a Chinese AAU case-control study (300 cases, 300 controls), A allele was associated with lower odds of AAU (OR 0.684, 95% CI 0.534–0.876; corrected p=0.03); AA genotype OR 0.624 (95% CI 0.452–0.862; corrected p=0.04). PMID:25075123.

entities.name: PMID:25075123
observations: Wang et al. reported a Chinese case-control study of CFI and CD46 variants in acute anterior uveitis; 300 cases and 300 healthy controls; rs7356506 A allele and AA genotype were associated with reduced odds.

entities.name: CFI-AAU protective association
observations: Single Chinese case-control study found rs7356506 A allele (OR 0.684, 95% CI 0.534–0.876; corrected p=0.03) and AA genotype (OR 0.624, 95% CI 0.452–0.862; corrected p=0.04) associated with lower AAU odds; this supports association, not causality. PMID:25075123.
